customSections.content: KUSD uses separate elementary, middle, high school, and Frank Elementary calendars. Check the calendar that applies to your student before using or importing a date below.

Boundary elementary, high school, or Frank

customSections.label: Schedule Rules That Vary by School
customSections.content: Shared closures apply across KUSD, but conference days, Friday schedules, and assessment days vary by school level.

rows: Middle and high schools generally follow full Friday schedules unless KUSD lists a specific half day or final-exam release.
For conferences, LakeView K-8 and Ruth Harman follow the middle-school dates listed by KUSD, not the boundary-elementary conference closures.
Attendance is grade-specific on March 9 and March 23; check the high school calendar before planning transportation.

customSections.label: Frank Elementary Follows an Alternate Calendar
customSections.content: Frank Enrichment Weeks run October 19–22 and 26–29, February 22–25, March 1–4, June 7–10, and June 14–17. Frank is closed October 23 and 30, February 26, and March 5. These dates belong only to Frank's alternate calendar.

customSections.label: Weather Delays and School Closures
customSections.content: KUSD generally announces emergency schedule changes by 5 a.m. through district text alerts, its website, Channel 20, social media, and local media. A two-hour delay cancels early childhood, speech impact, and 4K sessions; a full closure also cancels after-school and evening activities.

calendarFaqs.q: Does KUSD use one calendar for every school?
calendarFaqs.a: No. KUSD publishes separate boundary elementary, middle, and high school calendars, plus an alternate calendar for Frank Elementary. Shared closures align, but conferences, releases, assessments, and some school dates differ.

calendarFaqs.q: When does KUSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Boundary-school K-12 students start Tuesday, September 1, 2026, and boundary 4K starts September 8. Frank Elementary K-5 starts August 3 and Frank 4K starts August 10.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for KUSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: KUSD lists Thursday, June 3, 2027, as the last half day for all students. Frank Elementary separately lists Enrichment Weeks June 7–10 and June 14–17.

calendarFaqs.q: When are KUSD Winter and Spring Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027, with classes resuming January 4. Good Friday closes the district March 26, followed by Spring Break March 29–April 2; classes resume April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all KUSD elementary students leave early on Fridays?
calendarFaqs.a: The official boundary elementary and Frank PDFs mark Fridays as early-release days. Families should use their school’s published hours because dismissal time varies by campus.

calendarFaqs.q: Which conference dates apply to LakeView K-8 and Ruth Harman?
calendarFaqs.a: KUSD groups LakeView K-8 and Ruth Harman with the middle-school evening conference schedule and excludes them from the boundary-elementary conference release and no-school dates.

calendarFaqs.q: How do ACT and PreACT days affect KUSD high school attendance?
calendarFaqs.a: On March 9, juniors attend for the ACT and are released early; grades 9, 10, and 12 do not attend. On March 23, grades 9 and 10 attend for PreACT with early release while grades 11 and 12 do not attend.

sourceReviewDetails: The KUSD year page and all four English instructional PDFs were checked together because no single PDF contains the full district calendar.
Each one-page PDF was rendered and visually reviewed to confirm its color legend, quarter boundaries, closures, conferences, release patterns, and differences among the four calendars.
Spanish PDFs and English / Spanish assessment calendars are linked as official supporting resources but were not used to duplicate the English event set.

The four .ics files are one-time imports. Regular Friday early-release events are not included because dismissal times vary by school; families should confirm published hours and later schedule changes with their school.
